domain: Global Workforce Analytics and Compensation Management
scenario:
A multinational corporation is developing an advanced Workforce Analytics and Compensation Management System to track and analyze employee data across various regions. The system aims to provide insights into employment trends, salary distributions, and remote work dynamics within the organization. It must handle data from multiple countries, accommodate different currencies, and convert salaries into a common currency (USD) for comparative analysis.

The system will support different employment types (e.g., full-time, part-time, contract), experience levels (e.g., entry, senior, executive), and job titles to provide a comprehensive view of workforce composition. Additionally, the platform should enable the analysis of remote work prevalence and its impact on salaries and job satisfaction.

The organization requires detailed reporting capabilities to monitor workforce changes over time, understand regional salary variations, and optimize compensation strategies. The system must also include robust user management to control access based on roles, ensuring data security and privacy.

The platform should facilitate cross-departmental collaboration, allow for the integration of external labor market data, and support decision-making processes for HR and executive teams.
